verdict.rationale: SerpApi ships markdown output optimized for LLMs/agents, llms.txt discovery, and an official MCP server (serpapi-mcp) enabling direct tool-call consumption by agents, plus SDKs for programmatic use. However, there's no evidence of ready-made function-calling JSON schemas, no OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), and no documented native integrations with agent frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex. missing for 10: function-calling schema definitions, OpenAPI/JSON schema spec, first-party agent-framework integration docs (LangChain/AutoGPT/etc), independent confirmation the MCP server works well in practice.
